text.en: AWS re:Invent 2026 will take place in Las Vegas, NV, from November 30 to December 4.
text.es: AWS re:Invent 2026 se celebrará en Las Vegas, Nevada, del 30 de noviembre al 4 de diciembre.

text.en: The AWS re:Invent conference features more than 2,200 sessions across five days in Las Vegas.

text.en: The AWS re:Invent expo features more than 450 AWS Partners across every industry.
